questions.history: Package A and B together with the stated relocation.
questions.prediction: MSHADE-425 reports a duplicate-entry build failure for converging service descriptors. The merge should produce one META-INF/services/borg.foo.Svc containing borg.foo.First and borg.foo.Second, each once, and no old descriptor.
questions.basis: Both inputs name the same output interface after relocation, while their provider names are distinct. The landed transformer regression checks one output descriptor with concatenated lines.
questions.refutation: A packaging exception, both paths surviving, more than one final descriptor or loss of either provider.

questions.history: Package A alone with the same transform.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should produce one relocated descriptor containing just borg.foo.First and a loadable borg.foo.First class.
questions.basis: A single descriptor cannot collide with another path. Relocation applies to both the provider class and its advertised binary name.
questions.refutation: Either revision leaves the old descriptor name or emits a provider name absent from the JAR.

questions.history: Load the merged artifact in a fresh class loader with no fixture classes supplied by its parent. Resolve borg.foo.Svc there and iterate ServiceLoader.load(serviceClass, loader). Repeat with the two input artifacts presented in the opposite order.
questions.prediction: On the merge both orders should instantiate exactly the providers with class names borg.foo.First and borg.foo.Second, both assignable to the service class resolved by that loader. Discovery order may differ.
questions.basis: The service loader consumes the final descriptor and resolves actual provider classes. Reversing distinct contributors leaves the provider set unchanged.
questions.refutation: One provider disappears when the artifact order changes, provider instantiation raises ServiceConfigurationError or the classes implement a different interface identity.
